title: Yttrium ion as a platform for quantum information processing
summary: Engineering large-scale quantum computers which simultaneously provide high-fidelity quantum operations, low memory errors, low crosstalk, and reasonable resource usage remains an outstanding challenge across quantum computing platforms. In trapped ions, progress has largely focused on alkaline-earth and ytterbium ions, whose simple electronic structures facilitate control over their internal state.
